patient-explanation:
During the week that started on 21 April 2025 you ate two portions of the food identified as **FOOD‑1900** (butter). Each portion was 20 g, so the total amount of this food you consumed that week was **40 g**. The monitoring rule for this food (Rule 0006) says you should eat **less than 30 g** per week. Because 40 g > 30 g, the rule was broken. 

In addition, you ate one portion of **FOOD‑19014** (white chocolate) on 26 April 2025. That portion was 50 g. The rule for this food (Rule 0007) also requires you to stay **under 30 g per week**. Again, the amount you ate (50 g) exceeds the limit. 

So, for this week two separate violations were detected – one for butter and one for white chocolate. You may want to discuss with your health‑care team how to reduce the intake of these items to stay within the recommended limits.
